newsitem.title: USA: USA Detergents tackles operational problems.
newsitem.headline: USA Detergents tackles operational problems.

text.p: USA Detergents Inc said on Friday it was taking action to correct operational problems that hurt the company's fourth quarter earnings.

USA Detergents, a low-cost laundry and household cleaning products company, said it has named a vice president of distribution, hired several new employees in the distribution area and upgraded its facilities and systems.
The company's stock rebounded from Thursday's steep fall related to lower-than-expected quarterly earnings. USA shares were up 1-3/4 at 22-1/8 in afternoon trading on Nasdaq.
USA Detergents said the distribution woes were a result of moving too quickly to expand its manufacturing facilities. The company grew from one plant to four in 1996.

"In our attempt to satisfy the growing demand for our product, we moved too rapidly and incurred unanticipated and excessive costs in manufacturing, warehousing and distribution," said Uri Evan, USA's chairman.
"This increase in expenses was compounded by our inability, because of our distribution problems, to ship several million dollars of product in time for inclusion in 1996 revenues," Evan said.
